mapper.select: SELECT space_id,workspace_id,environment_id,generation,revision FROM pf.workspace_sandbox_slot WHERE id=1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM pf.workspace_environment WHERE space_id=#{spaceId} AND workspace_id=#{workspaceId}
SELECT FROM pf.workspace_environment WHERE space_id=#{spaceId} AND workspace_id=#{workspaceId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,space_id,workspace_id,environment_id,kind,status,effect_state FROM pf.workspace_environment_operation WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT request_hash,workspace_id,environment_id,operation_id FROM pf.workspace_environment_idempotency WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND actor_id=#{actor.userId} AND request_id=#{requestId}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace_environment_use WHERE environment_id=#{environmentId} AND status IN('CLAIMED','RUNNING','UNKNOWN'))
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace_environment_stop_receipt WHERE operation_id=#{operationId} AND exec_stopped AND callbacks_stopped)
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.workspace_environment SET generation=#{row.generation},fence=#{row.fence},state='PREPARING',image_id=#{row.imageId},policy_hash=#{row.policyHash},creation_command_id=#{row.creationCommandId},creation_fence=#{row.creationFence},operation_id=#{row.operationId},version=version+1,error_code=NULL,container_id=NULL,container_started_at=NULL,readiness_hash=NULL,last_activity_at=clock_timestamp(),updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{row.id} AND space_id=#{row.spaceId} AND workspace_id=#{row.workspaceId} AND version=#{expectedVersion}

UPDATE pf.workspace_sandbox_slot SET space_id=#{row.spaceId},workspace_id=#{row.workspaceId},environment_id=#{row.id},generation=#{row.generation},revision=revision+1 WHERE id=1 AND revision=#{revision} AND(environment_id IS NULL OR environment_id=#{row.id})
UPDATE pf.workspace SET environment_state='PREPARING',version=version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE space_id=#{spaceId} AND id=#{workspaceId} AND state='READY'
